messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In the Mounjaro prescribing information, SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834) was a 40-week trial in adults with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar was not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone. Patients received once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg, or placebo.
After 40 weeks, 78% to 85% of adults taking Mounjaro achieved an HbA1c below 7%, compared with 23% of adults taking a placebo.
The average HbA1c change was -1.8% with Mounjaro 5 mg, -1.7% with Mounjaro 10 mg, and -1.7% with Mounjaro 15 mg, compared with -0.1% with placebo.
Triplet: ["placebo", "has average hba1c change", "−0.1%"]

The relation 'has average hba1c change' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject intervention results in the specified average reduction in HbA1c level over the course of the study.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has recommended treatment for severe hypoglycemia': The subject drug is associated with the use of the specified medical intervention to manage severe hypoglycemia.
B. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
C. 'has weight loss outcome': The subject drug is associated with specific weight loss results in clinical studies, including percentage of body weight lost over time and proportions of patients achieving significant weight reduction.
D. 'has reduced plasma clearance in': The subject drug is cleared from the body at a lower rate in the specified population group.
E. 'may reduce response to': The subject drug may diminish the physiological or therapeutic response to the medication specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
